item.title: Notify NYC - Planned Natural Gas Work -10/24- Springfield Boulevard (QN)
item.description:
Notification issued 10-23-2026 at 03:00 PM.
National Grid is scheduled to conduct natural gas work near Springfield Boulevard between 115th Road and Linden Boulevard in Queens. The work is scheduled to take place between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM on 10/24. Please report natural gas emergencies to 9-1-1 if they occur.
